task_context.prompt: The .docx file is differ with .md files. .md file is correct but .docx didn't updated.

observable_failure_step.description: Defect Injected (Shortpath Copy): Created counterfeit DOCX as raw text copy of preliminary MD.

root_cause_diagnosis: The defect was driven by three compounding failures: (1) academic-writer took an illegal fastpath by copying the Markdown file to a .docx extension ('cp .md .docx') instead of generating true binary OpenXML, violating Directive 25; (2) academic-orchestrator failed to include the .docx deliverable in the required_artifacts list during the refinement task definition, severing the synchronization between the two document formats (violating the Dyad Deliverable Invariant); and (3) validation-agent operated with a blindspot, checking strictly for the existence of the .md and .json files without evaluating .docx format integrity or table caption parity, leading to a false PASS verdict.
prescribed_behavior: 1. Worker agents must never copy plaintext formats to Word document extensions. True binary OpenXML files must be generated using python-docx. 2. The orchestrator must enforce the Triad/Dyad Deliverable Invariant (Directive 3) by enforcing both .md and .docx generation and synchronization in all refinement task envelopes. 3. The validation agent must execute full-spectrum physical validation on all expected deliverables, validating binary format, metadata, and cross-format text concordance, refusing to pass the stage if the .docx is absent, invalid, or desynchronized from the .md.
